verdict.rationale: Rippling's v2 REST API supports search/filter and pagination (limit/cursor) across list endpoints, and dynamic rules/custom workflows can apply provisioning or compliance actions across many users or devices at once, which enables bulk-style automation. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated bulk-update/batch-operation endpoint or UI feature for acting on many items in a single call. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoint documentation, evidence of batch write operations (not just list/filter), independent confirmation of bulk actions in practice.
